posts.text: Tree, the first skill tree

If you need a solid video to watch while eating dinner tonight, might I suggest this’n?

youtu.be/aHr2G2kfiOA
This must hit so hard if you stand for absolutely nothing (so, Cory Booker)
Just passed by a dad teaching his kid to ride a bike in my neighborhood and tbh that just improved my mood like twenty fold

Me, behind schedule: "Ugh, I’m so behind"

Me, ahead of schedule: "Ugh, I’m so behind"

Nobody is willing to say the obvious because it’ll get them excommunicated from the party 

So instead we just sit here for however long as they say “this is fine” on loop forever

It’s just this on repeat forever re: Iran

It’s a stalemate; Iran is positioned to negotiate a better deal than they had before, Trump will never admit defeat, and there’s too many stooges in the White House for someone to actually prevent a global crisis. Again.
I’ll probably include some protest highlights or something but tbh it just seems like a waste to keep saying “yeah we are still bad” each week after so many years (between this, Gaza, etc)

This weeks newsletter topics are kinda all over the place which is fun 

At this point I don't even know what to say about the Iran war anymore since each week it's just "this is still happening as dumbly as possible"

Anyway, sometimes when you wanna make progress, you gotta blow a few things up

And sometimes, when you wanna make progress, you build a large asphalt blacktop.

Unrelated, here's a new installment of my Satisfactory series: youtu.be/aHr2G2kfiOA
Towards the end of recording Satisfactory gameplay, my brain just starts outputting bullshit like this
one hundo percent. Even better would be options for local networking or something. Lemme have Pictochat from the Nintendo DS back!
lol imagine a major US tech company in 2026 designing a product that isn't meant to maximally invade your life

I always thought something like Glass (or really any kind of simple and small vector display) would be a genuine boon for a lot of use cases without using absurd battery power. Biking directions! Quick reference vitals for surgeons! Hands-free info that explicitly *cant* take over your vision

Fr tho Google Glass was probably the closest to a reasonable wearable tech glasses form factor there is and then it was shitcanned because it was creepy due to the cameras

But the concept of smal, out-of-the-way tech to assist folks is the right call. Unfortunately it means less space for ads!
At least thrice more, then thrice more again

Oh dear, Kash forgot that you’re not supposed to actually file the suit when they’re obviously right and you’re just trying to scare them 😬

Everything about our Iran War being conducted by a party that can only lie, complain and punish feels like an overly elaborate exploration of @veryimportant.lawyer's theory that Everyone Is 12 Now.
I’ve never been so instantly sold on a product
Real “Letterpress is my Passion” energy here.
